description: The CLI coding agents installed through their OTHER route -- Homebrew, and npm for Claude Code -- so the identifiers 20-cli-agents cannot reach are exercised by a real install.
why: These four homebrew tokens read DID NOT APPEAR: 20-cli-agents and 25-python-agents install the same agents from npm and uv, so the Homebrew identifiers were catalogued and never produced by any run. A second route needs a second machine, because both routes claim the same binary name. Claude Code is here for the same reason in mirror image: 20-cli-agents installs it from the native installer, which leaves a shim and no npm row.
known_gaps: Installing proves the token. It does not run any of these agents, so state directories that only appear on first invocation (~/.codex, ~/.aider) are still not exercised here.
codex and copilot-cli are casks: on a runner the app bundle lands but is never launched, so anything written at first launch is out of reach for the same reason.
